summary.text: Chris West is a Republican member of the Maryland Senate for District 42, covering Baltimore and Carroll counties, first elected in 2018 and a senator since January 9, 2019 after serving in the House of Delegates from 2015 to 2019. His official page lists him on the Judicial Proceedings Committee.

paragraphs.text: West's official page says he was born in Baltimore in 1950, and lists a B.A. from Williams College in 1972 and a J.D. from the University of Pennsylvania in 1975.
It lists him as legal counsel to the Maryland Republican Party from 1982 to 1996 and from 1998 to 2003, and as a principal at Semmes, Bowen and Semmes, where he chaired the Business Law Department.
It says he is married with one child.
The page says he served on the House Health and Government Operations Committee from 2015 to 2019.
It lists his public service as including the State Commission on Criminal Sentencing Policy from 2021 and the Maryland Historical Trust from 2019.
